3.speaker: Lucita Azaro
3.text: "Despite the lack of immediate leads, I wasn’t convinced that it was a dead end."

4.speaker: Lucita Azaro
4.text: "My instincts told me there was more to uncover, and as it turns out, I was right."

5.speaker: Lucita Azaro
5.text: "One of my operatives managed to get in deep with a record keeper in the forensics department of Wehlen's Security Ministry."

6.speaker: Lucita Azaro
6.text: "This man was rather unhappy with his current situation and was... susceptible to persuasion."

7.speaker: Lucita Azaro
7.text: "After some delicate negotiations and the promise of a better life elsewhere, he agreed to help us."

10.speaker: Lucita Azaro
10.text: "We knew Wehlen’s databases were extensive, but rarely do they go back more than a decade in their routine checks. This was the key."

12.speaker: Lucita Azaro
12.text: "Sure enough, after some thorough searching, our contact found a match. The fingerprints we discovered at the bombing scene matched those of a man named Viktor Karnov."

13.speaker: Lucita Azaro
13.text: "He was arrested over 25 years ago for disorderly conduct and public intoxication. He was only 16 years old."

14.speaker: Player_Romus
14.text: "Viktor Karnov? Should I know who that is?"

15.speaker: Lucita Azaro
15.text: "Indeed, Your Majesty. Viktor Karnov is a well-known spy for Lespia."

16.speaker: Lucita Azaro
16.text: "Stationed at their consulate in Zille, he’s been operating under the radar for years, seamlessly blending into various roles and avoiding detection."

17.speaker: Player_Romus
17.text: "So who is he and why is he important?"

19.speaker: Player_Romus
19.text: "A part of me secretly wonders what it would be like to be arrested."

20.speaker: Player_Romus
20.text: Enough with the generalities. I need specifics. What exactly did your operative find that we don’t already know?"

21.speaker: Player_Romus
21.text: "Impressive work. I’m curious to know more about what was discovered.

22.speaker: Player_Romus
22.text: "Ah, the good old carrot-and-stick approach. It seems we’ve managed to find a willing ally with a little incentive."

23.speaker: Player_Romus
23.text: "Sometimes, the promise of a better future is all that's needed to turn the tide."

24.speaker: Player_Romus
24.text: "I can't say I condone such actions, but I suppose if it achieves the desired results, I can look the other way."

28.speaker: Titus Gordion
28.text: "Despite the lack of immediate leads from the fingerprints that were found at the scene, I wasn’t convinced it was a dead end."

30.speaker: Titus Gordion
30.text: "I had a gut feeling that there was more to uncover, and as it turns out, I was right."

31.speaker: Titus Gordion
31.text: "One of my operatives gained access to Wehlen's Security Ministry by infiltrating a network of underground informants and black-market traders."

32.speaker: Titus Gordion
32.text: "We'd previously identified a group of smugglers operating within Wehlen who occasionally dealt in sensitive information."

33.speaker: Titus Gordion
33.text: "My operative, Alexei, posed as a buyer interested in acquiring documents for a fictitious political rival."

34.speaker: Player_Romus
34.text: "So, they took him at his word?"

36.speaker: Titus Gordion
36.text: "In any case, he gained their trust and managed to acquire a trove of documents, including detailed forensic records from the Security Ministry’s archives."

38.speaker: Titus Gordion
38.text: "After meticulously combing through the records, we found a match for the fingerprints belonging to a man named Viktor Karnov."

39.speaker: Titus Gordion
39.text: "He was arrested over 25 years ago for disorderly conduct and public intoxication, which made him 16 years old at the time."

40.speaker: Player_Romus
40.text: "Viktor Karnov? Should I know who that is?"

42.speaker: Titus Gordion
42.text: "Based at their consulate in Zille, he’s been operating under the radar for years, effortlessly blending into various roles and evading detection."

43.speaker: Player_Romus
43.text: "Viktor Karnov... Viktor Karnov... Nope. Doesn't ring a bell."

44.speaker: Titus Gordion
44.text: "If your memory serves you well, he was the young man I sparred with at our first official meeting after your ascension to the throne."

48.speaker: Narrator
48.text: We took a seat around the council table. Titus handed each of us a large file, its contents nearly overflowing.

51.speaker: Narrator
51.text: I snapped back to reality upon entering the council room, reminded that I was there for a security briefing.

58.speaker: Narrator
58.text: Titus, ever the punctual one, was already present. And he wasn't alone. He was overseeing two men in uniform setting up a film projector and screen.

59.speaker: Titus Gordion
59.text: "There you are, Your Majesty. I'm pleased to see you."

60.speaker: Narrator
60.text: The three men, one by one, bowed in respect.

61.speaker: Titus Gordion
61.text: "As the new Royal Councilor of War and Internal Security for Rizia, I want to express my eternal gratitude for the trust you've bestowed upon me."

62.speaker: Narrator
62.text: Titus, ever the punctual one, was already present.

67.speaker: Player_Romus
67.text: "Excellent work. It requires great skill to execute such an infiltration."

68.speaker: Player_Romus
68.text: "I hope Alexei covered his tracks thoroughly. The last thing we need is Wehlen uncovering our involvement."

69.speaker: Player_Romus
69.text: "That sounds a bit far-fetched, but go on."

70.speaker: Player_Romus
70.text: "A trove, huh? Alright, let's see them."

71.speaker: Player_Romus
71.text: "I do hope these documents are genuine, or there will be consequences."

72.speaker: Player_Romus
72.text: "It’s fascinating how the shadows of society can reveal the most vital information."

75.speaker: Titus Gordion
75.text: “It goes without saying that the Friendship Day bombing has complicated matters regarding Zille's reunification with Rizia."

76.speaker: Titus Gordion
76.text: "However, what we've uncovered could be the breakthrough that tilts the situation back in our favor."

80.speaker: Titus Gordion
80.text: "As you know, you tasked me with investigating further into the possibility that Wehlen was responsible for the bombing."

81.speaker: Titus Gordion
81.text: "Even though the fingerprints found at the scene, provided by Wehlen, didn't give us any immediate leads, I still wasn’t convinced it was a dead end."

82.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
82.text: "As everyone here knows, I was tasked with resuming the foreign intelligence investigation into the infamous Friendship Day bombing in Zille."

83.speaker: Narrator
83.text: We all took our places around the council table.

87.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
87.text: "As previously uncovered, my department identified material from the bomb site that came straight from CircuitRise Systems in Pales."

88.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
88.text: "Upon further investigation, we managed to identify the man responsible for obtaining the material in the first place."

89.speaker: Narrator
89.text: Taddeus opened a large file folder he had brought in and handed out photos.

90.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
90.text: "We've narrowed it down to a man by the name of Aurelio Iturriaga who worked as a Chief Operations Officer at CircuitRise."

91.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
91.text: "Mr. Iturriaga exploited his exclusive access to tamper with inventory records, concealing the disappearance of vital materials."

92.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
92.text: "He manipulated dates, quantities, and descriptions, creating a deceptive trail to obscure his actions from scrutiny. Or so he believed."

93.speaker: Player_Romus
93.text: "This is excellent news. What of his present whereabouts?"

94.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
94.text: "Unfortunately, his trail ran cold. Any progress made was lost during the transition between Lucita's dismissal and my appointment."

95.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
95.text: "To put it plainly, we've hit a dead end."

96.speaker: Player_Romus
96.text: "Well, well... quite the diligent individual, I must say."

97.speaker: Player_Romus
97.text: "Impressive work, General. We're finally getting closer to uncovering the truth behind this ordeal."

98.speaker: Player_Romus
98.text: "So there is a culprit? He must be found and punished immediately."

99.speaker: Player_Romus
99.text: "A dead end? Unacceptable! We can't afford setbacks like this!"

100.speaker: Player_Romus
100.text: "I appreciate your honesty, General. It's a challenging situation. There's only so much you could have done."

101.speaker: Player_Romus
101.text: "Well, that's just great. Can we expect anything different at this point?"

102.speaker: Player_Romus
102.text: "I had hoped for better news, General. This is a setback we can ill afford."

103.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
103.text: "That's one way of putting it. That said..."

104.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
104.text: "Thank you. Unfortunately, any progress made was lost during the transition between Lucita's dismissal and my appointment."

105.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
105.text: "Unfortunately, that's as far as we got. Any progress made was lost during the transition between Lucita's dismissal and my appointment."

106.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
106.text: "I understand, Your Majesty. But unless new information presents itself, my hands are tied."

107.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
107.text: "No, Your Majesty. Not until new information presents itself. Until then, my hands are tied."

108.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
108.text: "I wish there was more I could do."

110.speaker: Narrator
110.text: The General nodded slightly, indicating his agreement, before gathering his files.

111.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
111.text: "If any new information comes to light, then I will pursue it with great diligence. But until then, my hands are tied."

112.speaker: Titus Gordion
112.text: "Well, if there's nothing more to discuss regarding the investigation, General, let's move on to the issue of Zille's impending reunification."

162.speaker: Lucita Azaro
162.text: 'I hate to say it, but I'm afraid we've hit a dead end."

163.speaker: Player_Romus
163.text: "What do you mean a dead end? This is unacceptable!"

164.speaker: Player_Romus
164.text: "I appreciate your honesty, Lucita. It's a challenging situation. There's only so much you could have done."

166.speaker: Player_Romus
166.text: "I had hoped for better news, Lucita. This is a setback we can ill afford."

167.text: "Believe me, I understand completely. But unless new information presents itself, my hands are tied."

168.speaker: Lucita Azaro
168.text: "No, Your Majesty. Not until new information comes to light, if ever. Until then, my hands are tied."

169.speaker: Lucita Azaro
169.text: "Thank you for understanding, Your Majesty. I wish there was more I could do."

170.speaker: Lucita Azaro
170.text: "I truly wish there was more I could do. But my hands are tied."

171.speaker: Lucita Azaro
171.text: "If any new information comes to light, I will pursue it with great diligence."

235.speaker: Narrator
235.text: It was fifteen past three. Lucita was late.

236.speaker: Narrator
236.text: I was here to be briefed on the latest updates on Zille, but it was beginning to look like a postponement was in order.

237.speaker: Narrator
237.text: Titus, punctual as usual, stood nearby.

238.speaker: Player_Romus
238.text: “It’s unusual for Lucita to keep us waiting like this.”

240.speaker: Narrator
240.text: Just as my eyes were beginning to veer toward the clock once more, the doors opened, and Lucita hurried in, clutching a folder.

241.speaker: Narrator
241.text: Two men in military uniforms followed her, pushing a film projector into the room.

242.speaker: Narrator
242.text: The trio's entrance spoke of urgency.

244.speaker: Lucita Azaro
244.text: “My apologies, Your Majesty. Urgent matters delayed my arrival."

245.speaker: Player_Romus
245.text: “I'll believe that when I hear it, Duchess."

246.speaker: Player_Romus
246.text: "Lucita did say she'd be here, yes?"

247.speaker: Player_Romus
247.text: "It seems Lucita is fashionably late to her own council meeting."

248.speaker: Player_Romus
248.text: "I don't suppose you know what Lucita intended to discuss today, do you?"

249.speaker: Player_Romus
249.text: "Lucita. So glad you could finally join us. I was beginning to think you got lost in the maze of palace corridors."

253.speaker: Player_Romus
253.text: "Let's hope this doesn't devolve into a wild goose chase, Lucita."

254.speaker: Narrator

255.speaker: Lucita Azaro

258.speaker: Lucita Azaro

265.speaker: Player_Romus

283.speaker: Lucita Azaro

313.text: "As previously uncovered, the Golden Guard identified material from the bomb site that came directly from TerraGrowth Agrochem."

314.speaker: Titus Gordion
314.text: "And since your orders directed us to focus the investigation on Wehlen, no further progress has been made on that lead."

315.speaker: Titus Gordion
315.text: "However, much to our surprise, a piece of evidence we had nearly dismissed has turned out to be the key to unlocking the entire investigation."

319.speaker: Lucita Azaro

321.speaker: Titus Gordion
321.text: "Despite the absence of immediate leads, I wasn’t convinced that it was a dead end."

322.speaker: Titus Gordion
322.text: "My gut told me there was more to uncover, and as it turns out, I was right."

336.speaker: Titus Gordion
336.text: "One of my operatives managed to gain access to Wehlen's Security Ministry by infiltrating an underground network of informants and black-market traders."

340.speaker: Titus Gordion
340.text: "We had previously identified a group of smugglers operating within Wehlen who occasionally dealt in sensitive information."

341.speaker: Titus Gordion
341.text: "My operative, Alexei, posed as a buyer seeking documents for a made-up political rival."

343.speaker: Titus Gordion
343.text: "Yes, Your Majesty. Alexei’s cover was impeccable."

344.speaker: Titus Gordion
344.text: "In any case, he earned their trust and secured a trove of documents, including detailed forensic records from the Security Ministry’s archives."

345.speaker: Titus Gordion
345.text: "If you recall, he was the young man I sparred with at our first official meeting following your ascension to the throne."

346.speaker: Player_Romus
346.text: "It’s fascinating how the shadows of society can yield the most crucial information."

347.speaker: Player_Romus
347.text: "Impressive work. It takes a lot of skill to pull off such an infiltration."

348.speaker: Player_Romus
348.text: "I hope Alexei covered his tracks well. The last thing we need is Wehlen discovering our involvement."

351.speaker: Player_Romus
351.text: "A trove, eh? Alright, let's see them."

352.speaker: Player_Romus
352.text: "Let’s not waste time. Bring those documents to me so I can examine them."

356.speaker: Titus Gordion
356.text: "A regrettable turn of events, Your Majesty."

357.speaker: Titus Gordion
357.text: "After Alexei acquired the documents, he arranged to meet with another operative to hand over the evidence in a remote location."

358.speaker: Titus Gordion
358.text: "However, on his way there, Alexei happened to be in the wrong place at the wrong time."

362.speaker: Titus Gordion
362.text: "I assure you, it was anything but convenient."

363.speaker: Titus Gordion
363.text: "Su Omina militants had planned an attack on a convoy of Wehlen supporters who want Zille to stay with Wehlen."

364.speaker: Titus Gordion
364.text: "When Alexei's car approached, it was caught in the crossfire."

365.speaker: Titus Gordion
365.text: "The militants, not distinguishing between targets, attacked and destroyed his vehicle."

366.speaker: Titus Gordion
366.text: "Alexei was killed instantly, and the documents were destroyed in the explosion."

369.speaker: Player_Romus
369.text: "Great. So you're saying this was all for nothing."

370.speaker: Player_Romus
370.text: "That's disappointing news. My condolences to your operative."

378.speaker: Lucita Azaro
378.text: "But to our surprise, a piece of evidence we had nearly dismissed almost turned out to be the key to unlocking the entire investigation."

379.speaker: Player_Romus
379.text: "I don't like the sound of this. What evidence?"

380.speaker: Titus Gordion
380.text: "However, a piece of evidence we had nearly dismissed nearly turned out to be the key to unlocking the entire investigation."

385.speaker: Lucita Azaro
385.text: "My operative managed to coerce him into digging deeper into their archives, far beyond the usual scope of their investigations."

388.speaker: Lucita Azaro
388.text: "Thank you, Your Majesty. It was an unfortunate turn of events."

389.speaker: Lucita Azaro
389.text: "An unfortunate turn of events. Yet, despite this setback, Su Omina could still be crucial to the success of Zille’s return."

390.speaker: Lucita Azaro
390.text: "While we may not have come to the desired conclusion, Su Omina's mistake is a lesson on how to refine our strategies and improve our approach to future operations."

395.speaker: Lucita Azaro
395.text: "He's a known spy for Lespia. That's who he is."

396.speaker: Lucita Azaro
396.text: "It involves a lot of paperwork and fewer royal privileges."

397.speaker: Lucita Azaro
397.text: "Let's hope you never have the pleasure of meeting him under such circumstances."

398.speaker: Titus Gordion
398.text: "Believe me, Alexei is the best of the best in covert operations."

399.speaker: Titus Gordion
399.text: "Alexei took all necessary measures to ensure his activities remain undetected."

400.speaker: Titus Gordion
400.text: "A reminder of the importance of exploring every angle, even those that seem obscure or inconsequential."

401.speaker: Player_Romus
401.text: "I knew enable Su Omina operations in ZIlle was a mistake."

404.speaker: Titus Gordion
404.text: "Thank you, sir. It was a most unfortunate turn of events."

405.speaker: Titus Gordion
405.text: "An unfortunate turn of events. However, despite this setback, Su Omina could still be crucial to the success of Zille’s return."

406.speaker: Titus Gordion
406.text: "Although we didn't acquire the desired result, Su Omina's mistake teaches us how to refine our strategies and enhance our approach to future operations."

408.speaker: Titus Gordion
408.text: "It just so happens that Viktor Karnov is a well-known spy."

410.speaker: Player_Romus
410.text: "Ha! Sounds like my kind of guy!"

414.speaker: Titus Gordion
414.text: "Let’s hope you never have the misfortune of meeting him under such circumstances. In any case..."

415.speaker: Titus Gordion
415.text: "Viktor Karnov is a noted spy for Lespia, though his activities are not widely publicized."

417.speaker: Player_Romus

418.speaker: Player_Romus

424.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
